name: 9 Pound Hammer
summary: **9 Pound Hammer** is a [[kind:cultivar|hybrid]] bred by Jinxproof Genetics in Washington State around 2010, crossing Gooberry with [[jesus-og|Jesus OG Kush]]. It was distributed through TGA Genetics until 2019, when it returned to Jinxproof's own catalog. The cultivar has since parented numerous further crosses.
